source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The added filtered-save scenario directly checks that bar, baz and subbaz exist and foo does not after accepting with the filter still active. All four final Assert.ok calls have only the Boolean expression, so the required expected-behavior messages are absent. Its earlier checkTreeRow calls do use the helper's non-empty diagnostics. Keep these direct checks separate from the later awaited-click repair and from remote server verification.
title: The filtered-subscription scenario adds four folder assertions without messages
